Quirks.description:
Quirks of this build that have built-in wokarounds.

There are a number of common issues, particularly in Ren'Py games that
flatpaker provides build steps to deal with.

force_window_gui_icon.description: Normally icons from a .exe or .icns if they are avilable, however, some games do not customize these icon sources but do provide a customized incon in the img directory. Setting this to true forces the use of that icon.
force_window_gui_icon.title: Force use of img/windows_gui/icon.png

x_renpy_archived_window_gui_icon.description: Extract an icon from an .rpa icon. This is deprecated, and is now an alias for force_window_gui_icon
x_renpy_archived_window_gui_icon.title: Extract the icon from an RPA archive.
